name: TCG Bot Boss
hook: Beat the 97 percent win-rate neural network before it steals your deck
tagline: Watch the glowing cybernetic trading bot evolve from rookie scrapper into an omniscient neon deity as multiplier rises. Cash out before its infinite turn plays every combo card on the felt table. If you crash, the bot plays an illegal 99-card exodia finisher that incinerates your hand.
